title: Dobara
logline: Meera enters the Rathore haveli as the new bride, steals a photograph of a man the family swears does not exist, and is still holding it when he walks through the front door.
look: Indian family drama, Lucknow haveli interior, warm tungsten and hard window light, carved teak furniture, jaali screens, dust in the light shafts, shallow depth of field, cinematic 35mm anamorphic, muted ochre and deep green palette, film grain, no on-screen text, no logos, no artwork on walls

meera.name: Meera
meera.ref_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 27-year-old North Indian woman, warm brown skin, large expressive dark eyes, long dark hair partly covered by a soft red-and-gold wedding dupatta, minimal gold jewellery, black-beaded mangalsutra, deep red bridal saree. Composed and watchful, the face of someone concealing something. Natural window light from camera left, warm haveli interior behind her, shallow depth of field. Looking straight at the lens, mouth closed, neutral expression. Head and shoulders, vertical 9:16 framing.

sushila.name: Sushila
sushila.ref_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 58-year-old North Indian woman, silver-streaked black hair pulled into a tight low bun, plain starched cotton saree in muted olive with a thin border, small gold earrings, thin gold bangles. No smile. Authority without warmth, eyes that give nothing away, deep lines at the mouth. Dim warm tungsten light in an old haveli corridor, shallow depth of field. Looking straight at the lens, mouth closed. Head and shoulders, vertical 9:16 framing.

kabir.name: Kabir
kabir.ref_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 33-year-old North Indian man, clean-shaven with faint stubble, side-parted black hair, tired guarded eyes, well-cut charcoal kurta. Handsome, decent, exhausted by something he will not name. Warm interior light, shallow depth of field. Looking straight at the lens, mouth closed, neutral expression. Head and shoulders, vertical 9:16 framing.

arun.name: Arun
arun.ref_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a 34-year-old North Indian man, close-cropped black beard, knowing amused eyes, plain dark kurta, broader and more weathered than his younger brother. Unhurried, faintly entertained, entirely unbothered. Warm daylight, shallow depth of field. Looking straight at the lens, mouth closed. Head and shoulders, vertical 9:16 framing.

shots.frame_prompt: Extreme close-up insert, vertical, of a woman's hands with mehndi and red-and-gold bridal bangles gripping an open maroon velvet wedding album on her lap. Her fingers are pulling one square photograph free from under the plastic film, the corner already lifted and bent. Thick card pages, warm window light from camera left, deep shadow around. Only hands and the album in frame, no face.
shots.motion: Her fingers tear the photograph free in one quick decisive movement and pull it out of frame towards her body. The album page settles back, now with an empty square. Her hands go completely still as if listening. Slight handheld tension.
shots.audio: A photograph tearing free of a plastic album sleeve, thick paper settling, and approaching footsteps on a marble floor. Large empty house room tone.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Sushila, a 58-year-old North Indian woman with a tight silver-streaked low bun and a muted olive cotton saree, facing camera directly in a grand haveli drawing room. Warm tungsten key light from the front on her face, the dim carved interior falling away out of focus behind her. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame.
shots.motion: She takes one step forward into the room and stops, looking directly at camera. She speaks, her mouth moving clearly. Her expression does not change. Camera static, very slight breathing motion.
shots.audio: Quiet interior room tone of a large old house, a distant ceiling fan turning slowly.

dialogue.speaker: sushila
dialogue.hi: इस घर में हर चीज़ की अपनी जगह है।
dialogue.en: In this house, everything has its place.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Meera, a 27-year-old woman in a deep red bridal saree and red-and-gold dupatta, facing camera directly. She holds the open maroon wedding album up at the very bottom edge of frame, one square on the page conspicuously empty. Warm window light from camera left across her face. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame.
shots.motion: She lifts the album slightly higher towards camera and speaks, her mouth moving clearly, her eyes steady and unblinking. A small challenging tilt of the head at the end of the line. Camera static.
shots.audio: Quiet interior room tone, thick album paper shifting in her hands.

shots.frame_prompt: Extreme close-up insert, vertical, of a single square wedding photograph held between a woman's fingers with red-and-gold bangles. In the photograph a row of Indian wedding guests in formal clothes stands at a mandap; at the centre a groom in a cream sherwani, and immediately beside him a 34-year-old man with a close-cropped black beard in a plain dark kurta who, unlike everyone else, is not looking at the camera lens but out of the picture straight at the viewer. Warm flash-lit wedding photograph, visible grain and a slight crease.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the photograph until the bearded man's face fills more of the frame. The photograph trembles very slightly in her fingers. Nothing else moves.
shots.audio: Room tone thinning, a low sustained unsettling tone rising very slightly underneath.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Sushila's face, 58 years old, silver-streaked hair in a tight bun, muted olive saree, facing camera directly. Warm tungsten key light from the front, the drawing room dark and out of focus behind her. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame, front-on, absolutely still.
shots.motion: She holds camera's gaze without blinking and speaks, her mouth moving clearly and precisely. On the last word the smallest hardening at the jaw. Camera static, no push-in.
shots.audio: Near silence, faint room tone of a large house, a clock ticking somewhere far off.

dialogue.speaker: sushila
dialogue.hi: इस घर में ऐसा कोई नहीं है।
dialogue.en: There is no such man in this house.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Kabir, a 33-year-old North Indian man with faint stubble in a charcoal kurta, standing in an interior doorway of the haveli, facing camera directly. Warm light from a window at camera right across his face, the dim corridor behind him soft and out of focus. His head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame.
shots.motion: He stops in the doorway, takes in the room, and speaks one short word, his mouth moving clearly. His eyes move from camera to the older woman off screen. Camera static.
shots.audio: Footsteps stopping on marble, quiet interior room tone.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Meera in her deep red bridal saree, facing camera directly, holding the single square wedding photograph up beside her cheek between two fingers so both her face and the photograph are clearly visible. Warm window light from camera left. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame.
shots.motion: She raises the photograph beside her face and speaks, her mouth moving clearly, her gaze locked on camera. She does not blink. Camera holds, the smallest push-in.
shots.audio: Quiet interior room tone, a ceiling fan turning.

dialogue.speaker: meera
dialogue.en: Who is standing next to you?

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Kabir's face, 33 years old, faint stubble, charcoal kurta, facing camera. Warm side light from camera right, the rest of the room falling into darkness. His face fills most of the vertical frame. He is not speaking.
shots.motion: He looks at camera and says nothing. His jaw tightens. His eyes drop away from camera and come back. One slow swallow. The silence stretches. Camera static.
shots.audio: Room tone dropping to near silence, one slow breath, a clock ticking far away.

shots.frame_prompt: Wide vertical shot down the length of a grand dim haveli entrance hall towards a tall closed double front door of carved dark wood. Hard afternoon light burns around the edges of the door frame from outside. Marble floor, a heavy unlit chandelier above, tall shuttered windows throwing bars of light across the floor. No people in frame.
shots.motion: The hall is completely still. An old mechanical doorbell rings twice, and dust drifts through the shafts of light. The camera pushes very slowly towards the front door.
shots.audio: An old mechanical doorbell ringing twice, echoing through a large empty stone house, then silence.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Sushila's face, 58 years old, silver-streaked bun, muted olive saree, lit warmly from one side in the dim drawing room. Her face fills most of the vertical frame. For the first time her composure is gone and there is fear underneath it.
shots.motion: Her eyes move sharply towards the sound off screen. Her mouth stays closed but the muscles around her eyes change. She takes one shallow breath she cannot control. She does not speak. Camera pushes in very slightly.
shots.audio: The last echo of a doorbell dying in a large house, a single sharp indrawn breath, room tone.

shots.frame_prompt: Vertical shot from inside the dim haveli entrance hall looking at the tall carved front door as it swings inward, flooding the frame with hard white afternoon daylight. A man's full-length silhouette stands in the doorway against the light, features not yet readable, dust and pollen blazing in the air around him. Marble floor catching the glare.
shots.motion: The door swings fully open and the man's silhouette takes one unhurried step into the hall. The camera adjusts exposure so the blown-out doorway begins to resolve. Dust swirls in the light.
shots.audio: A heavy wooden door being unbolted and swinging open, street sound briefly flooding in from outside, then a single footstep on marble.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Arun, a 34-year-old North Indian man with a close-cropped black beard in a plain dark kurta, standing inside the haveli entrance hall out of the doorway glare, facing camera directly, warm bounced daylight on his face. The bright doorway is a soft blown-out shape behind his shoulder. Faintly amused, completely at ease. His head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame.
shots.motion: He looks directly at camera, the corner of his mouth lifting, and speaks the full line, his mouth moving clearly and unhurriedly. On the last words his eyebrows rise very slightly. Camera static.
shots.audio: A large stone entrance hall with a slight echo, faint street sound from the open door behind him.

dialogue.speaker: arun
dialogue.hi: भाभी? किसी ने बताया ही नहीं कि कबीर ने दोबारा शादी कर ली।
dialogue.en: Bhabhi? Nobody told me Kabir had married again.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Meera's face, 27 years old, deep red bridal dupatta framing her face, facing camera directly. Warm window light from camera left, the hall dark behind her. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame, front-on. The stolen photograph is still held forgotten at the bottom edge of frame.
shots.motion: Her eyes widen very slightly as the word lands. She speaks one short word, her mouth moving clearly. Her breathing changes. The photograph slips a little in her fingers. Camera pushes in slowly on her eyes.
shots.audio: Room tone falling away to near silence, one caught breath.

shots.frame_prompt: Tight vertical close-up of Sushila's face, 58 years old, silver-streaked bun, muted olive saree, facing camera directly in the dim hall, hard side light from the open front door carving one edge of her face. Her head and shoulders fill the frame, the face occupying the upper two-thirds of the vertical frame, front-on. Composure fully restored, and colder than before.
shots.motion: She looks straight at camera and speaks flatly and finally, her mouth moving clearly. On the last syllable everything about her stops moving and she holds absolutely still, staring down the lens. Camera holds without moving, then the image freezes.
shots.audio: Complete room silence, then a single low sub-bass hit on the final word.

dialogue.speaker: sushila
dialogue.hi: कबीर का कोई भाई नहीं है।

end_card.line_hi: मीरा उस घर में बहू बनकर नहीं आई थी।
end_card.line_en: Meera did not come to that house to be a bride.
